notes.title: New Rare Colour Variants
notes.notes:
Added 10 new rare colour variants and achievements to go with them. 

Colour variants were added to:
[list]
[*] Bear
[*] Dragonfly
[*] Unicorn
[*] Pangolin
[*] Owlbear
[*] Griffon
[*] Nightmare
[*] snake
[/list]

Some creatures got more than 1 variation where 1 is even more rare than the other. 

Happy Breeding
